entities.name: Dodie Boy Peñalosa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Diosdado "Dodie Boy" Peñalosa is a Filipino former professional boxer who competed from 1982 to 1995. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior-flyweight title from 1983 to 1986 and the IBF flyweight title in 1987.
